what_this_is: Software evidence for the quieter loading presentation in app/src/components/BufferingWindow.tsx. Jest in an isolated worktree; no Vega build, simulator run or recording.
files_not_changed: PlayerScreen.tsx, Seekbar.tsx, home, navigation, copy and every other Codex-owned file. The snapshot file is unchanged.
before: A looping Lottie spinner appeared the moment any wait began.
In the player, a full-screen rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) layer at zIndex 5 appeared on every waiting or seeking event and left on every playing or seeked event, above the cover, captions and calm card.
Repeated seeks could therefore dim and undim the whole picture several times a second. The app's own flash-check inventory (ALL_UI_FRAMES) has no frame for this layer.
after_with_the_current_caller: A wait shorter than one second draws nothing: no dimming and no status.
A longer wait gets the translucent layer and a static Loading status, not a spinner.
Opaque screen loading, used by the Suspense fallbacks, keeps its black backdrop at once and its first frame is unchanged (the existing snapshot passes).
after_with_the_integration_patch: The player never dims or blanks the scene; picture, cover, still and card stay as they were.
A small Loading plate appears in the middle only after one second of continuous waiting, stays at least half a second, and never while the checking card already explains the wait.
An error hides the status and keeps Go back focused; the status sits below the error screen and takes no focus or presses.

full_app_suite.reference: results/native-checkpoint-2026-10-14/outer-only-full-tests.txt records 1198 passed on e51529c; this branch removes the 3 old spinner tests and adds 39

seen_to_fail: seen-to-fail.txt in this folder: eight deliberate breaks of the component each turned the focused tests red, and the restored file was byte identical and green.
integration_patch_verification: patch-verification.txt in this folder: the patch's own test fails 2 of 4 on the unpatched player and passes 4 of 4 with the patch; typecheck, lint and 125 existing player tests pass with the patch applied. The patch was then reverted.
not_done: No native build, simulator run or recording; the change has not been seen on Vega.
The Lottie dependency stays in app/package.json although nothing imports it now. Removing it changes the lockfile, the bill of materials and the build manifest, so it is left for Codex.
No frame for the loading plate was added to the app's flash-check inventory in uiFrames.ts, which is outside this lane.
